context: Two teens hype each other up before a quiz contest
purpose: Teach: 易い/あらわれ/混じっ/密か/つねに/ぜひとも/すむ/誘惑

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、いよいよだね！この大会のために、つねに全力で勉強してきたじゃん。
lines.en: Riku, this is it! We've been studying full-on nonstop just for this contest.
lines.style: Excited high-pitched teen girl voice, rapid casual speech.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、密かに自信あるんだ。特に方程式の問題は分かり易いやつが多いって聞いた。
lines.en: Yeah, I'm secretly confident. I heard the equation problems are mostly easy ones.
lines.style: Cocky teenage boy, casual confident tone, slightly hushed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ちょっと、フラグ立てないでよ！でも本当、サクラもぜひとも優勝したい！
lines.en: Hey, don't jinx it! But for real, I absolutely want to win the top prize too!
lines.style: Playfully scolding then enthusiastic, animated teen girl.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 途中で諦めの誘惑に負けそうになっても、お互い励まし合おう。
lines.en: Even if the temptation to give up halfway hits us, let's keep cheering each other on.
lines.style: Sincere supportive teen boy, slightly lowered earnest tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あ、見て！ライバル校のチームがあらわれたよ。緊張してきた…。
lines.en: Oh, look! The rival school's team just showed up. I'm getting nervous now.
lines.style: Whispered urgent teen girl, nervous excitement creeping in.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 大丈夫、緊張に期待が混じってる感じが一番いいんだって。
lines.en: It's fine, they say having excitement mixed in with nerves is actually the best state.
lines.style: Reassuring confident teen boy, calming friendly tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 本当だ、なんかスッキリした。終わったらすぐ気がすむまでクレープ食べに行こ！
lines.en: True, I feel refreshed now. Once it's done, let's go eat crepes until we're satisfied!
lines.style: Bright recovered teen girl, bouncy hopeful energy.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 決まり！じゃあ最良の結果を出して、堂々と優勝賞品もらおうぜ！
lines.en: Deal! Then let's pull off the best result possible and grab that winner's prize proudly!
lines.style: Pumped-up teen boy, rising rallying voice, fist-pump energy.
